adjusted_prescription: To safely navigate around the left-side fire cluster, it is important to start by following the corridor along the top edge of the grid, staying close to row 0. This route keeps the agent clear of fire hazards blocking the direct path and provides a safer alternative to moving through the center where fire is nearby. The agent should move right along the top row at the beginning of its journey, hugging the corridor tightly to avoid stepping onto any fire tiles. Once past the fire cluster on the left side, the agent can then gradually move downward and around hazards toward the goal. This strategy improves the chances of reaching the goal successfully by avoiding risky central paths that lead too close to fire. Following the top-edge route early in the trajectory is key to a safe and successful navigation.
